d:
Kaash ek chhadi mil jaye aur dal bina mehnat ban jaye! Dal Premix ready — bas paani mein gholo, ubaalo, garam dal ya soup taiyaar.
Moong + masoor dal bhunkar, masale ke saath peeskar jar mein bharein — 3 mahine tak tension free.
Dal Premix kaise banta hai — dhoke, sukhake, bhunkar
Masala chipakne se bachane ki trick
2-3 chammach premix paani mein gholke dal ya soup
Bina cornflour, colour, preservative — hostel, travel, busy din ke liye
Comment karein — ye premix kiske liye banayenge: hostel, travel ya ghar?
